# Events

The neighborhood calendar: the `events` collection, its listings and pages, and the "this week" block for CMS pages. In the CMS: `events` (drafts, scheduled publish, review-queue fields, an optional title band photo) and the `eventsThisWeek` block; not in the CMS: the upcoming and past rules, the paging and the filter row. Fields, access and hooks: [events content type](/docs/reference/content-types/events.md); the screens: [screens reference](/docs/reference/routes.md).

## Screens

| Screen       | Route                                                                            | Data comes from                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| All events   | `/events`                                                                        | `events`, upcoming and past, first page of each (`src/app/(frontend)/events/(index)/page.tsx`)                                                                  |
| Category     | `/events/category/[category]`                                                    | `events` in one `categories` doc (`.../(index)/category/[category]/page.tsx`)                                                                                   |
| Filter row   | above both                                                                       | `categories` that have published events, with counts (`use-cases/findEventFilterMenu.ts`); title and intro are hardcoded in `(index)/layout.tsx`                |
| Paged lists  | `/events/list/[scope]/[page]`, `/events/category/[category]/list/[scope]/[page]` | `events`; the no-JavaScript "Load more" target (`ui/EventListPage.tsx`)                                                                                         |
| Event        | `/events/[slug]`                                                                 | `events` by slug, draft in draft mode (`use-cases/getEventBySlug.ts`); the "Cancelled" text and the "More events" box are hardcoded in `events/[slug]/page.tsx` |
| This week    | block on any CMS page                                                            | the `eventsThisWeek` block's rows, then `events` (`use-cases/findEventsThisWeek.ts`); joined in `src/app/(frontend)/[slug]/pageBlocks.tsx`                      |
| Sidebar list | event and post pages                                                             | next 3 upcoming events (`use-cases/findUpcomingEvents.ts`); joined in `posts/[slug]/page.tsx`                                                                   |

## How the pieces link

- **[News](/src/modules/news/README.md)** owns the `categories` tree events use and the search index both feed (`src/payload.config.ts`, `searchPlugin`); the post page shows the events sidebar.
- **[Site](/src/modules/site/README.md):** the "this week" block sits in a page, and an event save refreshes every CMS page; the proxy sends `/events?category=x` to the category page and 404s malformed slugs (`src/proxy.ts`, decision 0015).
- **[Agents](/src/modules/agents/README.md)** are the usual source of suggested events: the review-queue fields come from [Shared Payload code](/src/platform/payload/README.md) (`cms/events.ts` via `holdSuggestions`).
- **Rich text:** an event's text uses the [rich-text](/src/platform/richtext/README.md) blocks (banner, figure and the editorial blocks) and its width rule; the title band photo is the shared `backdrop` group (`src/platform/payload/bandBackdrop.ts`, #1024).
- **Libraries doing real work:** Payload's search and jobs; schema.org `Event` data is made by `ui/eventJsonLd.ts`.

## Behaviors and events

- **A save refreshes the right pages:** a published event's save, an unpublish or a delete refreshes its page, `/events`, every category and list page, `/` and all CMS pages and expires the `events` and `events-sitemap` tags; a draft refreshes nothing (`cms/revalidateEvent.ts`).
- **Events can be scheduled to publish or unpublish** (`schedulePublish` in `src/platform/payload/contentCollection.ts`), run by Payload's jobs inside the app; event pages re-render every 10 minutes (`revalidate = 600`, decision 0011).
- **"Load more" asks for what follows the last item** by cursor, not page number; its action accepts only a known scope, a valid cursor and an existing category slug (`data/queries.ts`, `actions.ts`, decision 0014).
- **Events created by agents or non-staff are `suggested` drafts** with a source name and an http(s) link; staff publishing approves them; agents cannot update or publish (`cms/events.ts`, `src/platform/payload/reviewQueue.ts`).
- **The event page** has a plain title band and category, a metadata bar (`eventByline`: date with time, place with format), the whole `heroImage` as the first thing in the article column, and emits schema.org `Event` data (`ui/eventHeader.tsx`, `ui/eventJsonLd.ts`, #1002, #1013); Admin has Live Preview and a preview link from the draft.

## Shared pieces it uses

- Collection helpers from `src/platform/payload/`: `contentCollection`, `draftContentAccess`, `reviewQueue`, `seoTab`, `keyset`, `published`.
- Kit and layout: `Card`, `Badge`, `LoadMore.client`, `PageHeader`, `ArticlePage`, `CardGrid`; the site timezone from `src/platform/lib/timezone.ts`.
- Where it meets other modules (decision 0008): pages in `src/app/`, `pageBlocks.tsx` for the block, `src/payload.config.ts` for the collection, block and search.

## Rules and the tests that protect them

- **Upcoming means dated today or later in the Madison timezone;** past means before today, dates are day-only. Upcoming lists run soonest first, 12 a page; past lists newest first, 9 a page (`data/scope.ts`, `domain/scope.ts`; `data/scope.test.ts`, `domain/scope.test.ts`).
- **Cursor paging skips and repeats nothing** when events change (`data/queries.keyset.test.ts`).
- **Only published events show; cancelled ones stay** listed, counted, in "Load more" and the sidebar and openable, marked cancelled, with no register button (`data/listing.ts`; `use-cases/cancelledEvents.test.ts`). A past event's page has no register button and says "This event has passed."; a cancelled one says only that it is cancelled; today's keeps its button (`isPastEvent`; `src/app/(frontend)/events/[slug]/page.test.tsx`, #1012).
- **An event with `officialBody` is an official meeting:** labelled wherever it shows, with the body's `https://` agenda link on its page and the body as organizer in structured data; an agenda link that is not `https://` is refused (`domain/officialMeetings.ts`, `ui/OfficialAgenda.tsx`; `domain/officialMeetings.test.ts`).
- **The "this week" strip:** a row is `all`, `official` or one category; a window of 1 to 31 days (default 7) from today; at most 4 rows, 1 to 6 events each; empty rows are hidden, and with none left it shows a message (`domain/thisWeek.ts`, `data/thisWeek.ts`; `domain/thisWeek.test.ts`, `use-cases/findEventsThisWeek.test.ts`, `data/mappers.thisWeek.test.ts`).
- **A title band photo with no crop for a screen size uses the nearest crop that is set;** none set keeps the plain band (`src/platform/payload/bandBackdrop.ts`, `src/platform/ui/BandBackdrop.tsx`, #1024).
- **Every event states a place:** the venue name, else the address; "Online" for a virtual event (the editor hides its venue fields); "Location to be confirmed" when an in-person or hybrid event has none. The map link is the editor's `mapsUrl`, else a Google Maps search of the address (`domain/place.ts`, `domain/maps.ts`, #873; `domain/place.test.ts`, `ui/EventCard.test.tsx`, `ui/eventHeader.test.tsx`).
- **Category filters are pages, not query strings,** and counts and "Load more" keep the filter (`data/queries.filter.test.ts`, `domain/filters.test.ts`, `actions.test.ts`; `src/proxy.test.ts`). Revalidation names only routes that exist (`cms/revalidateEvent.test.ts`); suggestions are held (`src/payload.config.reviewQueue.test.ts`).

## Boundaries

- Entry files: `index.ts` (types and pure rules, safe for the proxy and clients), `server.ts` (server-only use cases and components), `cms.ts` (collection and block, never server-only). Layers: `domain/`, `use-cases/`, `data/`, `cms/`, `ui/`; no other module is imported (`eslint.boundaries.config.mjs`).

[0008](/docs/architecture/decisions/0008-compose-modules-at-the-app-level.md), [0011](/docs/architecture/decisions/0011-scheduled-publishing-runner.md), [0013](/docs/architecture/decisions/0013-cms-content-through-mappers.md), [0014](/docs/architecture/decisions/0014-cursor-paging-for-load-more.md), [0015](/docs/architecture/decisions/0015-event-filters-as-pages.md).

## Known gaps

- `featured` is unused: its description promises prominence on the home page, but no page, query or mapper reads it. Only `cms/events.ts` and the seed set it; the generated types and migrations also mention it.
- The filter row counts read every published event's category ids; fine for a small calendar (`data/categories.ts`).
